cycle.title: Circular reference
cycle.help: This formula depends on itself, directly or through other cells or sheets. Break the reference chain to calculate a result.

limited.title: Calculation limit reached
limited.help: The calculation could not finish within its limit. This cell may still show a saved result. Check the formula and its dependencies before using the value.

division.title: Division by zero
division.help: A division uses zero or an empty cell as its divisor. Check the divisor or handle this case with IF or IFERROR.

missing.title: Value not available
missing.help: The formula has no matching or available value. Check lookup values and ranges; NA() can also create this result deliberately.

name.title: Unknown name or function
name.help: Check the function spelling, named ranges and quoted text. A function that this engine does not support cannot be calculated.

intersection.title: Ranges do not intersect
intersection.help: The formula asks for an intersection of ranges that have no shared cells. Check range references and separators.

number.title: Invalid numeric result
number.help: A numeric argument is outside the functions domain or its result is outside the supported numeric range.

reference.title: Invalid cell reference
reference.help: The formula refers to a cell or sheet that no longer exists. Repair the reference or undo the deletion.

value.title: Invalid value or argument
value.help: An argument has an unsuitable value or type, such as text where a number is needed. Check the referenced cells and function arguments.

spill.title: Array result is blocked
spill.help: The array result cannot fill its destination cells. Clear blocking cells and check merged cells and the sheet boundary.

calculation.title: Calculation error
calculation.help: The formula could not produce a valid result. Check the expression, array dimensions and function support.

outline.title: Outline groups
outline.empty: This sheet has no outline groups.
outline.reloadHint: Changing an outline group reloads this workbook. The current undo history is cleared; cell contents and formatting are retained.
outline.invalidRange: Enter a valid row range (2:10) or column range (B:F). One row operation supports up to 10,000 rows.
outline.protected: Outline groups cannot be changed on a protected worksheet.
outline.readOnly: This workbook cannot be changed right now.
outline.overlapping: The file has overlapping column definitions. Resolve those before editing groups.
outline.tooDeep: A spreadsheet supports at most seven nested outline levels.
outline.summaryRequired: Keep a summary row or column beside the group to collapse it.

sheetProperties.reloadHint: This change reloads the workbook and clears its current undo history. Worksheet contents and objects are retained.
sheetProperties.keepVisible: A workbook must keep at least one visible sheet.
sheetProperties.noHidden: There are no hidden sheets available to unhide.
sheetProperties.veryHidden: This sheet is marked very hidden in the source file and cannot be unhidden here.
sheetProperties.structureLocked: The workbook structure is protected. Sheet visibility and tab colours cannot be changed.

discussions.title: Cell discussions and notes

errors.damaged: The discussion data is damaged or inconsistent. The original data has been kept.
errors.existingNote: This cell already has a note or discussion. Open it before making changes.
errors.missing: The discussion is unavailable or resolved. Reopen it to reply.
errors.invalidText: Enter an author and a message of at most 32,767 characters.
errors.protectedSheet: Unprotect the worksheet before changing its comments.

discussions.reloadHint: Saving or deleting a discussion reloads the workbook. Earlier undo steps will be cleared.

styles.title: Cell styles
styles.name: Style name
styles.reloadHint: Applying or saving a cell style clears earlier undo steps.

errors.invalidName: Enter a unique style name of at most 255 characters.
errors.duplicateName: A style with this name already exists.
errors.missingStyle: This style is no longer available.
errors.damagedStyles: The workbook contains inconsistent style definitions. Its original data has been kept.
errors.invalidFormat: Enter a valid font, colour, font size (1–409) and number format code.
errors.protectedSheet: Sheet protection does not allow changing these cell formats.
errors.noSelection: Select a cell before opening cell styles.
errors.invalidRange: Enter a valid cell range on this worksheet.

tables.title: Format as table
tables.name: Table name
tables.growHint: Type directly beside or below a table to expand it. With a totals row, insert a row above the totals to add data.

errors.invalidRange: Select a valid range containing data.
errors.overlap: The range overlaps another table or filter.
errors.mergedCells: Unmerge the cells before creating a table.
errors.occupiedTotal: The new totals row contains data. Choose another range or move those cells first.
errors.damagedTable: The table metadata could not be read safely.
errors.tooLarge: Use a range of at most 100,000 cells.
errors.renameTable: Renaming existing tables is not supported.

tables.reloadHint: Saving table settings or applying a table filter clears earlier undo steps.

pivots.title: Pivot table
pivots.name: Pivot name
pivots.dragHint: Drag source fields into an area, or select a field and use an Add button.
pivots.caption: Value caption
pivots.searchHint: Showing up to 200 members. Search to find more.
pivots.reloadHint: Creating or refreshing a pivot table clears earlier undo steps. Row and column changes that could move a pivot source or output may be refused to preserve its metadata.
pivots.legacyHint: This imported pivot is preserved with its cached results. Editing its field layout is not supported.
pivots.readSourceFirst: Read the fields again after changing the source.

errors.invalidSource: Use a rectangular range with unique, nonempty column headers and data rows.
errors.invalidFields: Choose valid source fields and unique field instances.
errors.invalidGroup: Choose a positive interval or valid date values.
errors.tooLarge: The source or resulting pivot exceeds the supported size.
errors.noValues: Add at least one value field.
errors.duplicateName: This pivot name is already used.
errors.invalidTarget: Choose a valid destination on the same sheet when refreshing.
errors.occupiedTarget: The destination contains data. Choose an empty area.
errors.overlap: The destination overlaps its source or another table.
errors.missingPivot: This pivot table no longer exists.
errors.unsupportedPivot: This pivot layout cannot be edited safely.
